gazetteer_names_needed.name: Peraea
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Herodian Peraea, the Transjordan strip east of the Jordan between Pella and the Arnon; Gilead stands in for it in the -4 split

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Decapolis
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: league of Hellenistic cities (Gerasa, Pella, Gadara, Hippos, Scythopolis...) in Transjordan and Galilee; a 40 km disc at Gerasa stands in for it in 63 BCE

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Iturea
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Ituraean country between the Beqaa/Hermon and Galilee; Golan and Hauran stand in for Philip's tetrarchy

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Trachonitis
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: the Leja lava field south-east of Damascus, part of the Hauran

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Batanaea
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Bashan, the northern Hauran east of the Golan

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Gezer
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Tel Gezer, about 34.92 E, 31.86 N; Jaffa stands in for it in the founding event

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Paropamisadae
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: alias of Kabulistan: the Kabul valley and Hindu Kush south slope, Hermaeus's realm

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Sagala
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: alias of Sialkot, about 74.53 E, 32.50 N, Menander's and Strato II's capital

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Swat valley
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: north of Gandhara; Menander's northern limit
